(NASDAQ:SMCI) reported Q4 adjusted EPS $1.70 and revenue ~$11.12B, missing analyst hopes as management saw revenue near the low forecast, while prosecutors charged nine over routing 130 Nvidia‑GPU AI servers to China even as SMCI gear will be pre‑tested for Cisco’s Secure AI Factory launching Oct 2026.
Super Micro Q4 Adjusted EPS, Revenue Miss
: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Q4 adjusted EPS $1.70, revenue about $11.12B—management said revenue sat near the low end of its forecast, below analysts' expectations.
: Taiwan prosecutors charged nine, including ex-SMCI staff, for allegedly routing 130 AI servers with high-end Nvidia chips to China; 74 shipped via Hong Kong/Indonesia, 56 intercepted in Taiwan.
SMCI Nvidia GPUs to Cisco Rack-Scale AI

: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) servers (liquid and air-cooled) with Nvidia GPUs will be pre-tested and offered as rack-scale AI systems integrated into Cisco’s Secure AI Factory, launching October 2026.
